recommendation: Keep the source-fix commit. It completes the published clarification in the current core extensibility page without broadening the change beyond the unknown non-modifier extension guidance or weakening the existing modifier-extension rule.
issue_request: FHIR-18362 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for N-Infra #50. It requested removing guidance that told applications to ignore unrecognized non-modifier extensions because that could be read as not storing or displaying them; the final resolution required not rejecting such instances, preserving unrecognized non-modifier extensions when possible, and ignoring them only when preservation is not possible.
initial_application: The 2022 FHIR easy changes commit acbede90b7f03015ad54c2a1383b13d92a6bc6ec applied FHIR-18362 to the Exchanging Extensions rule in source/extensibility.html, but it did not update the nearby Summary: Handling extensions bullet that still told readers to ignore other extensions except modifier extensions.
additional_context: FHIR-17699 had earlier added the modifier-extension exception to the same summary bullet, so the reconciliation needed to preserve special handling for modifier extensions. FHIR-I 2019-04-15 minutes support the preserve-if-possible interpretation, and a 2021 Zulip implementer thread shows the Summary bullet is still read as practical guidance.
reconciliation: Updated source/extensibility.html's Summary: Handling extensions bullet to say to process known extensions, preserve unrecognized non-modifier extensions when possible, ignore them only if preservation is not possible, and treat unrecognized modifier extensions specially as described above.
source_changes: source/extensibility.html: revised the Summary: Handling extensions bullet to replace the old 'ignore other extensions' guidance with preserve-if-possible wording and explicit modifier-extension special handling.

related_jiras.note: Published same-page clarification that added the modifier-extension exception to the Summary bullet; the FHIR-18362 fix preserves that distinction.
